sourceAtom.label: The Critical Digit Method for Rounding

inlines.text: Draw a “cut” after the required place value.
Decide to round up or down.
i. If critical digit is less than 5, round down.
ii. If critical digit is 5 or more, round up.
i. rounding down: Remove digits after the cut.
ii. rounding up: Add 1 to digit before the cut, carrying to the left if necessary, then remove digits after the cut.

entries.description: Rounding using the Critical Digit Method

The Critical Digit Method for Rounding
1. Draw a “cut” after the required place value.
2. Circle the critical digit right after the cut.
3. Decide to round up or down.
i. If critical digit is less than 5, round down.
ii. If critical digit is 5 or more, round up.
4. Round.
i. rounding down: Remove digits after the cut.
ii. rounding up: Add 1 to digit before the cut, then remove digits after the cut.
